rules.text: Sponsorship is invoiced by the Association and paid by bank transfer. It is never sold at checkout, through the payment provider, at renewal or beside a Purpose Fee.
Payment goes to the Association's general account and never to the fees account or the operations-reserve account directly.

Each month of the period, the unused balance settles that month's running-cost invoices of the Purpose Source activity that no one else supported, by name and amount, never above the month's direct costs; when the period ends, what is left moves to the operations reserve until it holds its target of CHF 27,000, and the rest stays for the Association's general costs.
Every sponsor is published by name, tier, period, amount and use. There is no anonymous or unlisted sponsor, because undisclosed support is prohibited.
A sponsor gets no say over the allocation, the Recipient List, the schedule, waivers, listings or anything else the Association decides.
Sponsorship buys no Entitlement, no coverage, no licence credential and no waiver, and none of it is passed on under the pledge.
No sponsorship offer appears in the checkout or renewal flows.
Every sponsor is screened against the sanctions lists before an invoice is issued, and the screening is recorded.
